answer: select round(100.0*count(distinct case when pa.defensive_work_rate='high' then p.player_api_id end)/count(distinct p.player_api_id),2) from Player p join Player_Attributes pa on pa.player_api_id=p.player_api_id where p.birthday>='1991' and pa.defensive_work_rate in ('low','medium','high')

with risky as (select distinct team_api_id from Team_Attributes where chanceCreationPassingClass='Risky'), cur as (select t.team_api_id,t.team_short_name,(select chanceCreationPassing from Team_Attributes a where a.team_api_id=t.team_api_id and a.date<='2014-09-19 23:59:59' order by a.date desc limit 1) v from Team t where t.team_api_id in (select team_api_id from risky)) select team_short_name, count(*) as club_count, round(avg(v),1) as avg_risk from cur group by team_short_name having count(*)>1 order by avg_risk desc, team_short_name

select round(avg(height),2) from Player p where birthday>='1990' and birthday<'1996' and (select defensive_work_rate from Player_Attributes a where a.player_api_id=p.player_api_id and defensive_work_rate in ('low','medium','high') order by date desc,id desc limit 1)='medium'
select round(avg(weight),1) from Player where player_api_id in (select player_api_id from Player_Attributes where preferred_foot='left')

select ta.buildUpPlayDribblingClass from Team t join Team_Attributes ta on ta.team_api_id=t.team_api_id where t.team_short_name='POR' and date(ta.date)='2015-09-10' and t.team_api_id in (select m.home_team_api_id from Match m join Country c on c.id=m.country_id where c.name='England')

with mp as (select country_id,home_player_1 p from Match union select country_id,home_player_2 p from Match union select country_id,home_player_3 p from Match union select country_id,home_player_4 p from Match union select country_id,home_player_5 p from Match union select country_id,home_player_6 p from Match union select country_id,home_player_7 p from Match union select country_id,home_player_8 p from Match union select country_id,home_player_9 p from Match union select country_id,home_player_10 p from Match union select country_id,home_player_11 p from Match union select country_id,away_player_1 p from Match union select country_id,away_player_2 p from Match union select country_id,away_player_3 p from Match union select country_id,away_player_4 p from Match union select country_id,away_player_5 p from Match union select country_id,away_player_6 p from Match union select country_id,away_player_7 p from Match union select country_id,away_player_8 p from Match union select country_id,away_player_9 p from Match union select country_id,away_player_10 p from Match union select country_id,away_player_11 p from Match) select c.name, count(distinct mp.p) n from mp join Player pl on pl.player_api_id=mp.p join Country c on c.id=mp.country_id where pl.weight>=210 group by c.name having n=(select max(n2) from (select count(distinct mp.p) n2 from mp join Player pl on pl.player_api_id=mp.p where pl.weight>=210 group by mp.country_id)) order by c.name
